name: BrowseComp
notes: The original benchmark.

name: BrowseComp-Plus
notes: Human-verified subset of the original questions over a frozen corpus.

name: XBCP (Cross-Lingual BrowseComp-Plus)
notes: No public code/data release.

name: BrowseComp-ZH
notes: 11 domains; questions reverse-constructed by Chinese experts. No multimodal version exists.

name: K-BrowseComp
notes: 300 Verified + 100 Synthetic; non-text sources disallowed by design.

name: SnapshotBrowseComp
environment: fixed snapshot corpus (8.2M JA + 45.5M EN documents)
notes: lite 200 + hard 50. No paper; repository is the primary source; no scores reported.

name: HyperBrowseComp
notes: Filtered from 500 candidates. No public code/data release.

name: MM-BrowseComp
notes: v1 (2025) had 224 questions; v2 (Jan 2026) expanded to 400. Both figures shown.

name: BrowseComp-VL
notes: Level 1: 199 + Level 2: 200 = 399 released; the paper's evaluation samples 300.

name: LiveBrowseComp
notes: Answers depend on facts from the 90 days before construction; 8 categories.

name: EvoBrowseComp
notes: Three-agent synthesis pipeline regenerates questions from the live web.

name: MedBrowseComp
best_reported: o3 Deep Research 25.5/50 on a 50-question subset
notes: Claimed '1,000+'; released splits: 605 deep research + 484 computer-use = 1,089. Both figures shown.

name: WideSearch
best_reported: Best multi-agent system ~5.1% exact success; item-level F1 up to ~80%
notes: 15+ domains; human-curated, five-stage QC.

name: DeepSearchQA
best_reported: Gemini Deep Research Agent F1 81.90 / Fully Correct 66.09%; GPT-5 Pro High 78.98 / 65.18%
notes: Paper dated Dec 2025; arXiv version Jan 2026. 17 domains. No official code repository.

name: Ko-WideSearch
modality: text, structured-table answers (4,262 gold rows / 14,560 cells)
notes: 190 set-valued parent entities, 16 categories, 3 difficulty tiers. Data on request; pipeline/scorer announced MIT but no public repo URL found.

name: ATLAS
modality: text, gold-table answers (2-10 attributes per entity)
notes: PREVIEW: tasks, gold tables and scorer not public as of early Nov 2026; all numbers vendor-run. 74% of tasks require >=10 entities.

name: WANDR
modality: text, set answers over 170,495 sourced records
best_reported: Perplexity Search-as-Code Soft F1 0.363 / Hard F1 0.133
notes: HF mirror has 501 rows vs 500 in the paper. Reference-free scoring (scorer re-fetches cited pages).

name: FinSearchComp
best_reported: Grok 4 (web) 68.9% Global; DouBao (web) leads Greater China
notes: ICLR 2026. 70 finance experts; three task families; single deterministic answers.

name: LoHoSearch
notes: Motivated by BrowseComp saturation (~90%). KG-driven construction: 7.62M entities / 265M edges; 11 domains; unique answers. No official code repo found.

name: xbench-DeepSearch
notes: Two separate 100-task releases (2505 IDs 1-100; 2510 IDs 101-200); scores not comparable across releases. Datasets encrypted. No arXiv paper.
